titulo: How to fix a hole in the wall

frases.texto: How do you fix a hole in the wall?
That doorknob punched the drywall, and the filler falls straight through.
Peel a metal patch and press it on, past the torn edge.
Spread three thin coats of joint compound, and let each one dry.
A thick blob shrinks into a hump. The last coat goes on wide.
Sand it lightly, prime it, and paint the same color.
Skip the primer, and the patch shows through the paint.
A doorstop on the baseboard keeps the knob off the wall.
Bigger than six inches, or a wire in the hole? Don't saw. Call a pro.
Send this to that friend whose doorknob went through the wall.
